newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Bandar Raya to list subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Bandar Raya to list subsidiary.

text.p: Malaysian property developer, Bandar Raya Developments Bhd, said it plans to list subsidiary Mieco Chipboard Bhd on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE).
It said in a statement to the KLSE that Mieco proposed to get listed with 210 million shares of one ringgit each.
The planned listing would include the issue of 180 million rights shares in the ratio of 12 shares for every one held at par value of one ringgit each.
It was also proposed to sell 140.04 million shares in Mieco to shareholders of Bandar Raya in the ratio of two shares for every seven held at two ringgit each.
The statement said 15 million new shares were proposed to be issued to the public at two ringgit each.
At present, Bandar Raya holds 98.9 percent of Mieco.
The statement said the issue and listing would help Mieco repay loans of 174.5 million ringgit to Bandar Raya and also fund its future expansion plans.
The listing was subject to approvals from the government, the Securities Commission, the KLSE and shareholders.
